notes.211v.1: hir, schuzblâtren and herdbrâte are unidentified eye ailments (schuzblâtren perhaps 'shot-blisters'). vel is taken as a film over the eye. winnente (211v.7) is read as swînende, 'dwindling'.

nodes.text: I conjure today your *hir*, by the holy Christ who gave himself up to martyrdom
for all mankind, by Saint Mary, mother of our Lord Jesus Christ,
and by the holy blood that ran from our Lord's side, and by the
holy birth, and by the holy ascension, and by the holy sepulchre,
and by the day of judgement: the film and the *hir* and the *schuzblâtren*,
the water-blister and the *herdbrâte* and all the sickness, N., that is [in]
your eye, that today it be dwindling, and that true sight
grow in it, according to your will, Lord. In the name of our Lord
Jesus Christ, may these words be true and firm and victorious for you. To this end
may the holy power of God help me; to this end may my holy lady
